clue.text: Occasionally, but not always, lit?

definitions.meaning: a lamp that keeps flicking between dark and lit is said to be this

explanation.surface: Someone describing a lamp that is only lit some of the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done intermittently happens at irregular intervals, and a flickering light alternates between dark and lit.

clue.text: Superfluous ornament on the coat farther down

parts.note: an animal's coat is its fur
farther down means lower, or below

explanation.surface: A needless decoration sewn lower down on a coat.
explanation.walkthrough: A FURBELOW is a showy frill or flounce on a dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A furbelow is a flounce or frill, a piece of showy trimming added to clothing.

clue.text: Afraid? Perhaps even I might be

indicators.note: might be suggests the words before it could turn into something else, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The setter admitting that even they might feel some fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges PERHAPS EVEN I into the answer; the surface reads as the setter admitting fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Fearing that something bad will happen is a milder way of being scared.

clue.text: Boring haircut for boy at Eton

parts.note: something boring is dull or dry
a bob is a short haircut

explanation.surface: A dull hairstyle given to a pupil at a famous school.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English boarding school; there a DRY BOB is a boy who plays cricket rather than rowing (a wet bob).
explanation.definitionFit: Eton slang names a pupil who chooses cricket over rowing in this way, as opposed to a wet bob.

clue.text: Name of architect not applicable? Then keep quiet!

parts.note: NA is the standard abbreviation for not applicable on forms
sh is the word said to tell someone to keep quiet

explanation.surface: Someone told a form field is not applicable and then to shut up.
explanation.walkthrough: John NASH was the Regency architect of Regent Street and Brighton Pavilion.
explanation.definitionFit: John Nash was the English architect behind much of Regency London.

clue.text: Make a great effort in the fight

explanation.surface: Someone straining hard during a brawl.
explanation.definitionFit: To strive hard against difficulty is the verb sense; a conflict or tussle is the noun sense.

clue.text: Nothing to be very fond of

definitions.meaning: zero, as in a tennis score

explanation.surface: A claim that nothing is worth adoring.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis scoring a zero is called LOVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis scoring calls a zero score by this word, and to adore someone is the verb sense.

clue.text: Note, young lady with Ray converted the secret agent

parts.note: E is a musical note
a miss is a young unmarried lady

indicators.note: converted means the letters of the name Ray are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl and a man called Ray turning a spy to their side.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy sent on a special, often covert, mission can be a secret agent.

clue.text: Wait here before finding space

parts.note: ante is the Latin-derived prefix meaning before
room means space

explanation.surface: An instruction to wait somewhere until space becomes free.
explanation.definitionFit: An outer waiting chamber is where visitors sit before entering the main room.

clue.text: It falls right into sink

indicators.note: into means the letter for right goes inside the word for sink

parts.note: to dip is to sink briefly

explanation.surface: Something tumbling straight down into a basin.
explanation.definitionFit: A single drop of liquid is something that falls.

clue.text: Mix with socially and massage joints!

definitions.meaning: to associate or mingle with people
taken literally, to knead the upper arm joints

explanation.surface: Socialising and giving someone a massage at the same time.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to mingle with people of a different set; literally it is kneading the upper-arm joints.

clue.text: Birth certificate?

parts.note: a birth is also a delivery, and the paper signed when a parcel is handed over is the certificate

explanation.surface: An official record of someone being born.
explanation.definitionFit: The document accompanying goods handed over confirms their arrival, and childbirth is likewise called a delivery.

clue.text: Beginning to be with square characters

parts.note: alpha, the first Greek letter, means the beginning
a T-square is a drawing tool, so T can stand for square

explanation.surface: Advice to start out by being one of the honest, square types.
explanation.definitionFit: The full set of letters used in writing is the set of characters.

clue.text: Banker in Lisbon

parts.note: a banker here is something that has banks, a river, and this one flows through the Portuguese capital

explanation.surface: A financier working in Portugal's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: This river of Spain and Portugal reaches the sea at Lisbon, and a river has banks.

clue.text: Lead sulphide from a man in Georgia

indicators.note: in means the words for a and man sit inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
Len is a man's name

explanation.surface: A mineral obtained from somebody living in Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: This grey mineral is the chief ore of lead, chemically lead sulphide.

clue.text: Bird, one leaving young lover

indicators.note: leaving means the letter for one departs from the word for young lover

parts.note: a swain is a young lover or suitor
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: One partner walking out on a youthful sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: A swan is a large long-necked water bird.

clue.text: Aware that one's show, ing good judgement

definitions.meaning: ... of something means conscious of it
practical and reasonable; the comma is a printing slip

explanation.surface: Someone realising they are being level-headed.
explanation.definitionFit: An old use means conscious or mindful of something; the usual sense is level-headed and reasonable.

clue.text: Plant a listening device on the French horn

parts.note: to bug a room is to plant a hidden microphone
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Spies hiding a microphone in a French horn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French horn' reads as one instrument, but 'the French' gives LE and 'horn' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bugle is a simple brass horn used for military calls.

clue.text: Member of both a legal and an illegal union

definitions.text: Member of both a legal and an illegal union

parts.words: Member of both a legal and an illegal union
parts.note: someone wed a second time while still wed: the first marriage is lawful, the second is not

explanation.surface: A trade unionist in one lawful and one banned organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who marries while already married has one valid and one unlawful marriage.

clue.text: Virginia has number of lines that are different

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
RY abbreviates railway, a network of many lines of track

explanation.surface: A remark that Virginia's poems differ in their line counts.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that differ from one another are said to diverge or change.

clue.text: Move to another house in another street with the Parisian

indicators.note: another means the letters of street are made into a different arrangement

parts.note: le is the word for the in French, as a Parisian would say

explanation.surface: Relocating to a home on a different road, together with a Frenchman.
explanation.definitionFit: To relocate and make a new home somewhere is to establish yourself again in a fresh place.

clue.text: Seeing that money goes into drink

indicators.note: goes into means the money word is put inside the drink word

parts.note: nog is a drink, as in eggnog
tin is slang for money

explanation.surface: Someone observing that their cash is spent on alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Observing or remarking is a sense of the participle, as in observing that it rained.

clue.text: Lampooner took his seat, with endless anger, at the front

parts.note: sat means took his seat

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the anger word is cut off

parts.note: ire is anger
at the front means first, written 1ST, with I for 1

explanation.surface: A satirical writer sitting down, furious, in the front row.
explanation.definitionFit: A lampooner ridicules people in writing, which is the work of a mocking satirical writer.

clue.text: Man of the cloth

parts.note: usually a clergyman, but read literally someone who works with cloth by making suits

explanation.surface: A priest or minister.
explanation.definitionFit: A maker of suits literally works with cloth, though the phrase normally means a clergyman.

clue.text: Break for burial task?

parts.note: to inter is to bury, so it stands for burial here
a mission is a task

explanation.surface: Asking whether a pause is time off for a grave-digging job.
explanation.definitionFit: An interval or pause in a performance is a break.

clue.text: School shop to fold?

definitions.meaning: the ... shop sells snacks at a British school
to make a fold or pleat in fabric

explanation.surface: A school shop asking whether to close down.
explanation.walkthrough: Tuck is British school slang for snack food, sold in a tuck shop.
explanation.definitionFit: British schools call snack food and its shop by this name, and a stitched pleat is also one.

clue.text: Pip one of the top tennis players

definitions.text: one of the top tennis players
definitions.meaning: a player ranked so as not to meet another top player early

explanation.surface: Pip described as an elite tennis player.
explanation.definitionFit: A pip is the kernel from which a plant grows, and tournament rankings place top players apart.

clue.text: Promise a hot cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters of a hot are mixed up

explanation.surface: A pledge of a warm mixed drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn vow is a sworn promise.

clue.text: Permit Oriental publican

parts.note: to license is to permit
E stands for East, and Oriental means eastern

explanation.surface: Allowing an Asian landlord to run a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: A British publican runs a pub, and needs a licence to sell alcohol, so is the holder of one.
explanation.definitionFit: A publican holds a licence to sell alcohol in a pub.

clue.text: Kenneth risked going out when it became more gloomy

indicators.note: going out means the word for risked goes outside the short form of Kenneth

parts.note: dared means risked
Ken is short for Kenneth

explanation.surface: Kenneth daring to go out as the evening grew darker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going out' says DARED goes round KEN.
explanation.definitionFit: When the sky grows dimmer or a mood turns sombre, it turns darker.
